constraints: BB-155 must be DELIVERED before Worker implementation begins; this task extends V2 rather than adding compatibility behavior to legacy Blackboard.
JEV remains an independent judge. A RepairReflection is epistemic state and may authorize a repair attempt, but it cannot assert correctness, readiness, mergeability or delivery.
LOOKBACK is a first-class read-only V2 lifecycle phase, not a hidden boolean inside REPAIRING.

All supervision subjects bind exact workId, workGeneration, Attempt and JevDecision/candidate/evidence identities. Any stale generation or stale attempt/decision binding is SUPERSEDED and cannot advance state.
Decision/reflection publication follows V2 CAS semantics. Mutating side effects require the current Attempt fence; reads/context/nextActions do not.
Material-progress checks happen before another JEV provider dispatch. Control/prose-only changes never count as implementation or evidence progress.
nextActions remains pure/deterministic over the canonical V2 snapshot; supervision cannot introduce controller-local clocks, mutable hidden state or prose-inferred routing.
invariants: A non-satisfied candidate judgment never grants source-write repair authority directly.
LOOKBACK is read-only; only an exactly bound current RepairReflection can authorize LOOKBACK -> REPAIRING.
A JevDecision/RepairReflection whose workGeneration differs from current spec.generation is SUPERSEDED and cannot mutate status/phase.
Supervision retry eligibility is derived from immutable Decisions plus current Attempt candidate/evidence identity; no duplicate authoritative SUPERVISION_STATE is introduced.
Material-delta guards run before provider dispatch and ignore Blackboard/control/prose-only churn.
nextActions remains pure/deterministic over `(spec,status,decisions)` and exposes LOOKBACK/repair blockers without hidden state.
architectureDecisions: D1 — Extend the BB-155 executable lifecycle with first-class LOOKBACK between failed candidate JUDGING and REPAIRING. IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT and/or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE route to LOOKBACK; PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION returns to research; SATISFIED routes to MERGE_PENDING.

D2 — Model actor lookback as REPAIR_REFLECTION_V1 owned by the current Attempt, not as a Decision and not as correctness Evidence. It binds `{workId,workGeneration,failedDecisionRef,attemptId,candidateSha,candidateTree,evidenceRef,evidenceHash,findingSignature}` plus one diagnosis per failed finding and a strategyRevision.

D3 — Publishing a RepairReflection is a V2 CAS mutation. Publish rereads current Work/Attempt/Decision, requires exact workGeneration and failed-decision/attempt/candidate/evidence bindings plus current Attempt fence, then transitions LOOKBACK -> REPAIRING. Any mismatch returns SUPERSEDED or STALE_FENCE and leaves state unchanged.

D4 — Keep JEV as the independent judge. RepairReflection may authorize one repair attempt because the actor explicitly revised its understanding, but it cannot mark any criterion satisfied. Only fresh candidate/evidence followed by a new valid JevDecision can resolve findings.

D5 — Derive findingSignature deterministically from the immutable failed JevDecision as hash(sorted(nonSatisfied questionId + ':' + choice)). Compare with the previous failed candidate Decision for the same Work generation: a changed signature selects DIAGNOSIS; the same signature selects STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION. Do not persist duplicate repeatCount/finding-summary authority when it can be derived.

D6 — Put material-progress semantics into the V2 lifecycle/next-action guard for JUDGE_CANDIDATE. IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT requires candidate-tree delta from the failed Attempt; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE requires evidence-hash delta; mixed failures require both. RepairReflection/control metadata never counts toward these deltas.

D7 — `nextActions(spec,status,decisions)` remains pure. In LOOKBACK it exposes only read/reflect/publish-reflection actions and no product-source mutation. In REPAIRING it exposes repair mutation under the current Attempt fence. Before JUDGING it returns JUDGE_CANDIDATE blocked with NO_MATERIAL_DELTA until the required candidate/evidence change exists.

D8 — ContextBuilder consumes lifecycle output rather than defining supervision policy: LOOKBACK context includes the exact failed Decision, candidate/evidence refs, diagnosis obligation and empty write scope; REPAIRING context includes the accepted RepairReflection and current repair scope.

D9 — BB-157 depends directly on BB-155. At Worker start bind exact delivered V2 lifecycle/control-store/decision APIs; if delivered seams contradict this plan, return to RESEARCH_SA instead of adding a legacy compatibility path.
implementationSlices: S1 — V2 supervision model: implement finding projection/signature plus REPAIR_REFLECTION_V1 validation with exact Work generation/Attempt/Decision/candidate/evidence binding.
S2 — Lifecycle integration: add read-only LOOKBACK and exact CAS/fence-governed LOOKBACK -> REPAIRING publication.
S3 — Anti-spam guard: derive material-progress requirements from failed JevDecision and block JUDGE_CANDIDATE before provider dispatch until candidate/evidence deltas exist.
S4 — Repeated-finding supervision: derive DIAGNOSIS vs STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION from immutable decision history without duplicate supervision state.
S5 — Context/operator integration: expose correct LOOKBACK/REPAIRING contexts and next actions, then prove stale generation/fence/no-delta behavior fail closed.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Failed candidate judgment enters read-only LOOKBACK and never directly grants REPAIRING/source-write authority.
evidenceRequired: Transition tests for IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, mixed failure, SATISFIED and PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Only an exact current REPAIR_REFLECTION_V1 bound to workGeneration, failed Decision, Attempt, candidate and evidence can transition LOOKBACK -> REPAIRING.
evidenceRequired: Positive publication fixture plus stale generation, stale decision, stale attempt and stale-fence negatives.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A new JUDGE_CANDIDATE action is blocked until failure-class-specific candidate/evidence material progress exists; prose/control-only changes never satisfy the guard.
evidenceRequired: Candidate-only, evidence-only, mixed and control-only delta fixtures.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Repeated identical failed finding signature selects STRATEGY_RECONSIDERATION from immutable Decisions; changed findings select DIAGNOSIS without duplicate authoritative repeat state.
evidenceRequired: Decision-history fixtures proving same/different signature behavior.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: RepairReflection never satisfies correctness; only a new valid JevDecision over fresh candidate/evidence may transition to MERGE_PENDING.
evidenceRequired: Negative fixture where reflection exists but no fresh judged candidate cannot advance.

A stale-generation, stale-decision, stale-attempt or stale-fence RepairReflection authorizes repair.
